question: How does a second tab see an append at cp-08?
diagram:
flowchart LR
  subgraph tabA["Browser tab A"]
    A["plan page · WebSocket · router.invalidate"]
  end
  subgraph tabB["Browser tab B"]
    B["plan page · Resolve form"]
  end
  subgraph web["apps/web · Worker"]
    WS["route /plans/$planId/ws"]
    SF["server fn · apiCommand"]
  end
  subgraph api["apps/api · Worker"]
    H["Hono · GET /plans/:planId/ws"]
    HC["Hono · POST /plans/:planId/commands"]
    DO[("PlanRoom DO · acceptWebSocket · broadcast")]
  end
  A -- "ws upgrade · same origin" --> WS
  WS -- "proxied over the service binding" --> H
  H -- "fetch(request) · upgrade" --> DO
  B -- "ResolveThread" --> SF
  SF -- "service binding" --> HC
  HC -- "RPC · dispatch" --> DO
  DO -- "events frame" --> A

steps.caption: Tab A opens a WebSocket to its own origin and never to the api.
The web route forwards the upgrade request over the service binding.
Hono hands the raw request to the plan's Durable Object.
The Durable Object accepts the socket and lets it hibernate.
Tab B resolves a thread through the same command path as cp-05.
After the append, dispatch broadcasts the new events to every open socket.
Tab A hears the frame and reloads its data, and nothing polls.
